title: Launch, Hardening, and Adoption
brief: Turn the connected platform into a production-ready operating system with launch gates, command-center visibility, replay and audit tooling, and rollout materials that drive confident adoption on the shop floor and in management workflows.

phases.title: Launch Readiness + Command Center
phases.description: Build the production command center, launch-readiness scoring, replay tooling, and adoption surfaces needed for a confident rollout.

units.title: Shop command center + dashboard integration
entry_conditions: Workflow, execution, and sync engines all expose live health and operational signals.
Dashboard and role-aware shell surfaces are ready for production command-center wiring.
exit_conditions: A unified command center surfaces launch-critical health, blockers, live shop load, and sync readiness.
The dashboard consumes the same platform-wide operational narrative.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Remove the command-center layer and fall back to separate operational dashboards if the aggregate view is not ready.

steps.instruction: Build a shop command-center engine that summarizes live execution, shortages, approvals, sync health, and launch blockers.
Integrate the command-center model into the dashboard so leaders can see one operating picture at sign-in.
steps.validation: Dashboard KPIs can drill into the same underlying command-center records and queues.

deliverables.description: Unified production command-center engine for launch and daily operations.
Dashboard integration with command-center summaries and drilldowns.

units.description: Shop command center + dashboard integration — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Launch readiness + replay engines
entry_conditions: The business has identified rollout gates, readiness thresholds, and recovery expectations.
exit_conditions: A launch-readiness engine scores configuration, data health, adoption, and sync safety before production rollout.
A replay engine can inspect and reconstruct recent live operational events for debugging or training.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Disable readiness scoring and replay tooling if they produce unreliable gates or burdensome storage costs.

steps.instruction: Build a launch-readiness engine that scores operational, sync, policy, and adoption preconditions for go-live decisions.
Build a replay engine that can reconstruct recent traveler, labor, workflow, and sync events for debugging and operator coaching.
steps.validation: Readiness scoring and replay records can explain why the system is or is not ready to launch.

deliverables.description: Go-live readiness scoring engine across data, sync, workflow, and adoption dimensions.
Replay and inspection engine for recent operational and sync events.

units.description: Launch readiness + replay engines — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Shop-floor adoption updates + rollout playbook
entry_conditions: Launch readiness and replay outputs are available.
The shop-floor tracker is already structured for a mobile-first execution flow.
exit_conditions: The shop-floor experience reflects launch-readiness cues, coaching aids, and replay-aware troubleshooting.
A rollout playbook exists for phased adoption, owner responsibilities, and recovery paths.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Remove the launch cues and revert to the previous tracker UX if adoption changes create confusion.

steps.instruction: Update the shop-floor clock page so workers and leads can see launch cues, recovery guidance, and replay-backed troubleshooting context.
Write an operations rollout playbook covering phased launch, ownership, fallback paths, and adoption metrics.
steps.validation: The playbook maps directly to launch-readiness dimensions and command-center signals.

deliverables.description: Shop-floor adoption and launch-readiness experience updates.
Production rollout playbook for the ultimate shop operating system.

units.description: Shop-floor adoption updates + rollout playbook — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

custom_checks: Launch readiness has measurable gates tied to live system signals.
Replay and dashboard tooling can explain failures and adoption blockers quickly.

phases.title: Forge-Triple Launch Controls
phases.description: Provide launch command surfaces and hard production gates with release validation coverage.

units.title: Launch gate command + readiness template
entry_conditions: The launch-readiness engine and rollout playbook exist.
Operators need a standard go-live and rollback checklist surface.
exit_conditions: A launch gate command doc exists for readiness review, go-live, rollback, and recovery checks.
A forge-triple readiness template exists for future launch and adoption work.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Remove the command and template docs if rollout policy changes before launch.

steps.instruction: Write a launch gate command doc that covers readiness review, blocker inspection, rollback triggers, and post-launch checks.
Create a readiness template that future release milestones can reuse for launch scoring, replay evidence, and adoption notes.
steps.validation: The command doc and template use the same readiness dimensions and rollback vocabulary.

deliverables.description: Slash-command style guide for go-live readiness, rollback, and release inspection.
Forge-triple template for launch-readiness, replay, and adoption reviews.

units.description: Launch gate command + readiness template — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Production readiness gate + release proof
entry_conditions: Readiness criteria and command docs are in place.
The platform is close enough to launch to validate end-to-end release behavior.
exit_conditions: A production-readiness gate can block release when safety, sync, policy, or adoption thresholds fail.
A release proof validates the full operational platform before go-live.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Disable the new release gate if it blocks valid launches for reasons the business cannot yet support.

steps.instruction: Implement a production-readiness gate that checks launch score, sync health, role policy coverage, and workflow stability before release.
Build a release proof that exercises core shop execution, role-aware shell access, workflow coherence, and sync propagation end to end.
steps.validation: The release proof demonstrates that the platform can run the connected shop workflow without major contract drift.

deliverables.description: Production gate enforcing launch readiness across the connected platform.
Release proof for the end-to-end ultimate shop operating system.

units.description: Production readiness gate + release proof — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

custom_checks: Launch commands map directly to live readiness and rollback signals.
Release validation proves the integrated shop platform can run safely end to end.

tool_map.purpose: Build command-center, readiness, rollout docs, and release tests
Check readiness scoring and replay coverage
Review production gate and release proof quality

existing_leverage.usage: Operational queue aggregation for the launch command center
Leadership landing surface for the unified operating picture
Worker adoption surface and launch coaching lane
